message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage, and I was so glad I finally took the time to get my emergency supplies in order! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some battery-powered lanterns, and it felt great to finally be the prepared one for once. I even had my power bank ready to keep my phone charged, because let’s be honest, I didn’t want to miss any updates from the outside world. It was a cozy evening spent playing board games by lantern light, and I realized that a little planning can turn an unexpected situation into a fun family memory. 

Do you have any tips or tricks for staying comfortable during a blackout?
